issues.title: JWT token not containing user role
issues.error: User role not available in session data when accessing protected routes
issues.rootCause: Missing role propagation in NextAuth JWT callback
issues.solution: Add explicit role mapping in JWT callback function
issues.context: The NextAuth JWT callback needs to explicitly add all user properties needed in the session. Role was missing resulting in permission issues.

issues.title: Session expiration not handling refresh correctly
issues.error: Users being logged out unexpectedly even with remember me checked
issues.solution: Update session configuration with appropriate maxAge
issues.context: The session maxAge determines how long a session remains valid. Without an explicit value, sessions were expiring too quickly.

issues.title: Middleware not correctly protecting routes
issues.error: Unauthenticated users able to access protected dashboard routes
issues.solution: Update matcher to include all protected paths
issues.context: The matcher pattern needs to include all protected paths with wildcards to catch all nested routes.
